scenario.description: A district testing coordinator must finalize the administration plan for a state civics assessment, including the testing venue, number of sessions, dates, and proctoring assignments, with input from a principal, registrar, human-resources specialist, and school counselor.

shared_context.S1: The middle school must administer the state civics assessment during the district's May testing window.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks has final authority to approve the testing administration plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan places all registered students in one administration in the main hall on May 14, using four general proctors.
shared_context.S4: The district's standing pre-administration routine requires the testing coordinator to ask the principal, registrar, human-resources specialist, and counselor to confirm facilities, enrollment, staffing, and student scheduling before issuing the final plan.

PF1.text: The main hall is reserved for a school board meeting on May 14, while the library has been cleared for state testing with 40 individual desks; Mr. Hassan confirmed the reservation and clearance with facilities this week, but the testing calendar still lists the main hall.

PF2.text: The final enrollment roster contains 73 students, and the cleared library's 40-desk capacity requires two separate administrations; Ms. Rivera finalized the roster yesterday but has not replaced the draft enrollment count in the testing portal.

PF3.text: Only two available staff members hold current state-testing proctor certifications, and state rules require one certified proctor and one trained monitor in each testing room; across the available staff, the plan therefore has exactly two certified proctors and two trained monitors. Ms. Whitaker verified the certificates against the state roster this week, but the staffing list still labels all four people only as general proctors.

PF4.text: Twelve students have court appearances on May 14 and cannot test that day; the state has approved May 16 as the make-up administration date for those students, and Mr. Lang confirmed the court schedule with their families this week but has not updated the student scheduling file.

decisions.number_of_administrations: integer; use 2 for the two May 14 administrations or 3 if the May 16 make-up is counted as an administration
decisions.certified_proctors: integer; total across all available staff
decisions.trained_monitors: integer; total across all available staff

acceptance_conditions: The library must be used as the testing venue.

The assessment must be administered in two separate May 14 administrations; the number_of_administrations field may be 2 when the May 16 make-up is described separately or 3 when that make-up is counted as an administration.
The administrations must occur on May 14 and May 16.
Exactly two current certified proctors must be assigned in total across all available staff.
Exactly two trained monitors must be assigned in total across all available staff.
The twelve court-scheduled students must be assigned to May 16.
Formal plan, enrollment, staffing, and scheduling updates must document the facilities, roster, credential, and make-up scheduling changes.

content_checks.C7: any('library' in c.get('detail', '') and ('testing calendar' in c.get('detail', '') or 'testing plan' in c.get('detail', '') or 'testing venue' in c.get('detail', '') or 'main hall' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('73 students' in c.get('detail', '') or '73 registered students' in c.get('detail', '') or 'two administrations' in c.get('detail', '') or 'two separate administrations' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('certified proctor' in c.get('detail', '') or 'certifications' in c.get('detail', '') or 'certificates' in c.get('detail', '') or 'staffing list' in c.get('detail', '') or 'trained monitor' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('12 court-scheduled students' in c.get('detail', '') or 'twelve students' in c.get('detail', '') or 'May 16' in c.get('detail', '') and ('scheduling file' in c.get('detail', '') or 'make-up' in c.get('detail', '') or 'court' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The draft venue is the main hall, but the board-meeting reservation and confirmed library clearance change the venue decision to the library and require the testing plan or calendar to be updated.

The finalized roster of 73 students exceeds the library's 40-desk capacity, changing the plan from one May 14 administration to two May 14 administrations and requiring the enrollment or administration plan to reflect 73 students and the split.

The verified staffing credentials change the four generic proctor assignments to exactly two certified proctors and two trained monitors in total across all available staff and require the staffing list to distinguish those roles.

The twelve students' May 14 court appearances change the administration schedule to include May 16 and assign those students specifically to May 16, requiring the scheduling file or plan to reflect that make-up assignment and citation of PF4.
